scope: Targeted correction of political-entity chronology; refreshed status evidence for the 17 profiles previously marked living; nine additional references for selected existing events. This is not a new review of all 1,098 event claims.
scopeZh: 本轮仅校正政治实体年代、复查原17份在世人物档案的状态证据，并为9项既有事件补充来源；并非重新核验全部1098项事件。

newSources.reviewNote: Full article text reviewed. Gives Tung’s death date and the 20 September memorial attendees; condolences by Hu Jintao are not assigned an exact action date. A later direct-open retry timed out, but the complete indexed article text was read again.
Official mourning release body reviewed. Corroborates death by 9 September; it is not the source for the exact 8 September date. Subsequent retrieval retries timed out.

Main release body and attendance list reviewed. Records Sam Hou Fai’s speech, Edmund Ho and former chief executives Fernando Chui and Ho Iat Seng at the 1 October reception. Later direct-open retries timed out.
Speech body reviewed; the opening salutations identify Carrie Lam as a former chief executive attending the occasion.
Reporter’s event report and caption reviewed. Lists Donald Tsang among former chief executives attending the 1 July flag-raising ceremony; no later office is inferred.
Full event report reviewed; only Chen’s attendance at the Xizhuang neighborhood-office unveiling on 6 September is used. Private-family reporting is not incorporated.
Body reviewed: the foundation released a statement attributed to Ma and an image of his manuscript on 22 May. Used only as dated status evidence; medical allegations are not adopted.
Body reviewed. Cites a foreign-ministry release on Tsai’s participation in Italy during 22–25 June; report publication on 27 June is separated from the activity window.
Full report reviewed; explicitly identifies Xi as CPC general secretary, PRC president and CMC chairman at the 30 September reception.

Complete indexed article text reviewed after direct open failed. Names Hu Jintao and Wen Jiabao among retired leaders visited before publication; the individual visit dates are unspecified. This is the same Xinhua report family as the existing newspaper PDF, not independent corroboration.
School-history body reviewed: Sun boarded in 1879 and graduated in 1882. The page’s 2016 celebration mention is not treated as its publication date.

Article page 19 reviewed, including passenger-list evidence: departure on 11 September 1920 and arrival in Marseille on 19 October. DOI: 10.3406/xxs.1988.2793. The event retains year precision rather than an unsupported summer label.

Full report body reviewed. Original report dated 10 January 1976 cites alumni/enrollment records, June 1917 graduation, subsequent Japan study and departure for France in 1920. Later editorial corrections in the report are respected.
Institutional-history body reviewed: Chen Duxiu’s appointment as dean and arrival in 1917 are stated. This additional source supports the year and role, not the original event’s January precision.

Biography body reviewed. Describes Liang’s Tsinghua teaching from the period after 1925; corroborates institution and role. Exact 1925 appointment remains sourced to the original Tsinghua archive. No publication date is inferred solely from the URL.
Full body reviewed: assignment to Soviet study in autumn 1928 and arrival in Moscow near year-end are stated. Intermediate stops are not converted into new atlas events.

changes.retrievalNote: Body reviewed: Li Qiang, explicitly identified as State Council premier, met the Kyrgyz prime minister in Hangzhou on 23 September 2026.
Current biography body reviewed. States assumption of office on 1 July 2022; footer says last revision September 2026. Month precision is preserved.
Current presidential timeline read: latest dated entry is 27 August 2026, chairing the eighth Healthy Taiwan Promotion Committee meeting. The entry date is not a publication date.
Former-president biography body reviewed: Cornell LLM and LSE PhD are stated, with return to Taiwan in 1984. It does not independently supply the 1980 Cornell award year.

Body reviewed again: death in the 8 April 1946 aircraft accident is explicit. The page combines party-history, newspaper and historical-magazine material; official hosting does not establish neutral or independent sourcing.

eventReferenceChanges.noteZh: 学校历史页记载孙中山于1879年入读并寄宿、1882年毕业，补证1879年檀香山求学；学校自身记录与中山市传记分属不同机构来源。
eventReferenceChanges.noteEn: The school history records boarding in 1879 and graduation in 1882, supporting the 1879 Honolulu schooling event. This is distinct institutional provenance from the Zhongshan biography.

eventReferenceChanges.noteZh: 论文第19页依据旅客名单记载1920年9月11日启航、10月19日抵马赛；支持1920年赴法，不能支持旧条目的“夏”。保留年度精度，不把法国区域点改成精确航线。
eventReferenceChanges.noteEn: Page 19 uses passenger-list evidence for departure on 11 September and arrival in Marseille on 19 October 1920. It supports the year and France, but contradicts the former summer label. No exact itinerary is inferred from the regional node.

eventReferenceChanges.noteZh: 北大校史同时记载蔡元培聘陈独秀任文科学长及陈于1917年来校；补证学校、职务和年份。1月这一月份仍仅由原党史来源支持。
eventReferenceChanges.noteEn: Peking University’s history records Cai’s appointment of Chen as dean and Chen’s arrival in 1917. It corroborates institution, office and year; January still relies on the original party-history source.

eventReferenceChanges.noteZh: 南开档案报告依据同学录与学籍记录记载1913年至1917年就读，并于1917年6月毕业；补证天津南开毕业的学校和年份。
eventReferenceChanges.noteEn: The Nankai archival report cites alumni and enrollment records for attendance in 1913–1917 and graduation in June 1917, corroborating the school and graduation year.

eventReferenceChanges.noteZh: 南开报告记载1917年毕业后赴日本、1920年赴法国；支持原条目的两国求学经历。该合并条目未拆为新事件，也未被赋予一个虚构的共同日期。
eventReferenceChanges.noteEn: The Nankai report records Japan study after the 1917 graduation and departure for France in 1920. It supports the two-country study record; this composite event is neither split nor assigned an invented single date.

eventReferenceChanges.noteZh: 南开历史学院传记提及1925年以后任教清华及国学四大导师身份，补证学校和职务；1925年这一确切任职年仍依原清华档案，不把此任教记录当成就学。
eventReferenceChanges.noteEn: Nankai’s biography places Liang’s Tsinghua teaching in the period after 1925 and identifies the tutorial role. It corroborates institution and role; the exact appointment year remains based on the original Tsinghua archive. This is a teaching, not student, event.

eventReferenceChanges.noteZh: 总统府卸任总统传记列康奈尔法律硕士及赴美求学，补证学校、学位与国家；未列1980年授予日期，年份仍依康奈尔原来源。
eventReferenceChanges.noteEn: The former-president biography lists a Cornell LLM and study in the United States. It corroborates institution, degree and country, but not the 1980 award date, which remains sourced to Cornell.

eventReferenceChanges.noteZh: 总统府传记列伦敦政经学院博士及1984年返台；补证学校、学位与留英经历。确切博士授予年仍采用伦敦政经学院原声明。
eventReferenceChanges.noteEn: The presidential biography lists an LSE PhD, study in Britain and return to Taiwan in 1984. It corroborates institution, degree and country; the exact award year remains sourced to LSE’s statement.

eventReferenceChanges.noteZh: 文章记载1928年秋受派赴苏、年底抵莫斯科并入中国劳动者共产主义大学；补证年份、城市和学习性质。两篇官方历史叙述是否共享底本尚未确立，不称为完全独立证据。
eventReferenceChanges.noteEn: The account records assignment to Soviet study in autumn 1928 and arrival in Moscow near year-end to enter the Communist University of the Toilers of China. It supports year, city and study; independence from the original official biography’s underlying material is not established.

corrections.reasonZh: 叶挺于1946年4月8日逝世，不能具有1949年成立的中华人民共和国的本人任职或活动归属。移除这一后见性政权标签；保留有生平证据的中共关联。
corrections.reason: Ye Ting died on 8 April 1946, before the PRC was founded in 1949. Remove the retrospective regime affiliation while retaining the documented CPC relationship.

corrections.reasonZh: 以2026年9月的公祭报道及立法会声明替代2018年的过时在世状态；未新增事件或迁移节点。
corrections.reason: Replace the stale 2018 living-status evidence with the September 2026 memorial report and Legislative Council statement; no event or route node was added.

corrections.reasonZh: 删去与档案研究启航及抵达日期冲突的季节标记，保留共同支持的1920年。
corrections.reason: Remove the seasonal label contradicted by departure and arrival dates in the archival study; preserve the mutually supported year 1920.

limitations: Source grades describe provenance, not neutrality or independence. Two URLs, two hosts, or two institutions do not necessarily mean two independent accounts.
Additional references sometimes support only the institution, location or year; unsupported finer precision continues to depend on the original citation and is stated in the reference note.
Living status is bounded by a dated activity or report. No profile is certified alive or in office through the dataset cutoff merely because the review occurred then.
The entity audit checks all 72 active profile labels against recorded lifespans and biographies for clear anachronisms. It is not a comprehensive independent verification of every affiliation.
No people, event IDs, locations or new route nodes were added. Raw legacy records remain available and may contain superseded values.

entityAudit.findings: Only Ye Ting’s PRC attribution was a certain lifespan contradiction in the active arrays. Labels include states, parties, administrations and military organizations; presence of a label is not proof of citizenship or continuous membership.
